decides: Whether this is OneWorld and how many subsidiaries exist
notes: Everything. COA, items, every transaction.

decides: Whether Multiple Currencies gets enabled
notes: Item pricing, customer/vendor records, consolidation

decides: Whether to provision OneWorld now for entities that do not exist yet
notes: Retrofitting OneWorld later is a migration, not a setting change

decides: Fiscal calendar shape: 12-month, 4-4-5, or 13-period
notes: Every period-based report; close checklist

decides: Whether inventory is tracked by location
notes: SEQUENCING: enable BEFORE loading items and BEFORE the first period you intend to open. No inventory transaction can be dated earlier than the enable date.

decides: Which items need lot or serial traceability
nsSetting: Enable Features > Lot Tracking / Serialized Inventory
notes: Item type per SKU; assembly structure; recall + cert reporting

decides: Whether buy/stock/sell units differ
nsSetting: Enable Features > Multiple Units of Measure
notes: Item records; PO and SO entry; inventory reporting. NOTE: MUOM is the PREREQUISITE for Statistical Accounts, not the reverse.

decides: Whether any product is sold by catch weight
nsSetting: No native support - SuiteApp or custom design
notes: Cannot be modelled with standard UOM conversion. Must be scoped before item build.

decides: Production tier: assembly builds, work orders, or WIP + routings
nsSetting: Enable Features > Work Orders / WIP & Routings / Advanced BOM
notes: Item setup, costing depth, shop-floor process, close tasks

decides: Whether an intermediate/WIP stage exists
notes: Costing depth; whether WIP items are needed

decides: Whether inventory can exist but be unavailable to sell
nsSetting: Enable Features > Inventory Status (+ statuses, Make Inventory Available for Commitment)
notes: Availability logic; whether the system can promise product that cannot legally ship

decides: Whether formal inspection records are needed
notes: Module scoping; receiving and shop-floor process

decides: Whether freight/duty/handling capitalize into inventory
notes: Item cost accuracy; margin reporting; close

decides: Whether receipt is a separate transaction from the bill
notes: 3-way match integrity; WHEN costing posts (receipt vs bill)

decides: Whether deferred/subscription revenue needs scheduling
notes: Revenue reporting; item revenue config. Expensive module - do not enable speculatively.

decides: Sales tax engine and nexus handling
notes: Every sales transaction; filing

decides: Whether per-unit and non-financial metrics are needed
nsSetting: Enable Features > Statistical Accounts (auto-enables Multiple UOM)

decides: Whether a fixed asset register is needed in NS
notes: Module scoping; depreciation posting

decides: Whether budget-vs-actual is needed in NS financials
nsSetting: Native Budgets (no cost) vs NetSuite Planning & Budgeting (separate product)
notes: Module scoping. Native budgets cover most needs.

decides: Whether demand forecast stays external
nsSetting: Demand Planning module (likely NOT needed) + inbound/outbound interface
notes: If forecast stays external, Demand Planning comes OFF the quote and an interface goes ON.

decides: Transaction volume and record counts

notes: License tier; whether integrations need batching

decides: Full users vs Employee / Customer / Vendor Center vs no-login integration

decides: How many years of history migrate vs archive

decides: Which 'accounts' are really dimensions in disguise and get collapsed

decides: Every axis the business slices by

decides: Reporting cuts done manually in Excel today

decides: Axes leadership wants but has never had

decides: Base currency and consolidation rates

decides: Intercompany transfer pricing policy

decides: Period locking and who may post to a closed period
